chunks.subject: AP Government
chunks.title: Q2 Quantitative Analysis (4 points) — Set 2: Senate elections & party alignment
chunks.content: AP Government FRQ 2, Quantitative Analysis, 4 points, one per part A/B/C/D, data-based. Set 2 answer key: A [1] identify the percentage of Senate elections won by candidates of the same party as the state's presidential vote (from the data); B [1] describe a trend/pattern in the data; C [1] draw a conclusion linking the data to a political actor/institution; D [1] explain how the data relates to a course concept (e.g., partisanship, straight-ticket voting, nationalization of elections). Same A/B/C/D task template as Set 1. Common failure: restating a value for B instead of a trend; for D, re-describing rather than explaining a cause.

chunks.subject: AP Government
chunks.title: Q2 Set 2 exemplar — Sample 2A, 4/4
chunks.content: Q2 (Set 2) scored 4/4 — identified the data value, described a trend, drew a conclusion, and explained a course-concept relationship. Full-credit model.

chunks.subject: AP Government
chunks.title: Q2 Set 2 exemplar — Sample 2B, 3/4
chunks.content: Q2 (Set 2) scored 3/4 — earned three parts (identify, describe, and one of conclusion/explanation), losing one — commonly the D explanation that requires a course-concept cause rather than restating the trend.

chunks.subject: AP Government
chunks.title: Q2 Set 2 exemplar — Sample 2C, 1/4
chunks.content: Q2 (Set 2) scored 1/4 — earned only the data identification A, losing the trend description, conclusion, and explanation. Illustrates a response that reads a single value but cannot analyze the data or connect it to concepts.
